scope: Two spectra extracted independently at two supplied chromatographic retention times
claim_boundary: Supports or conflicts with same-compound identity; does not assign R/S or prove enantioselective enrichment
change_from_v1: Promote the paper-derived 10-second precursor-fragment RT half-window; retain v1 unchanged as the historical RT8 definition

rt_half_window_seconds.source: Wang et al., Orthogonal molecular annotation in mass spectrometry with AdductMLib

fragment_coelution_min_pearson.source: Wang et al., Orthogonal molecular annotation in mass spectrometry with AdductMLib

precursor_eic_tolerance_ppm.future_action: calibrate against measured mass error and independent truth data

spectrum_min_relative_intensity.future_action: calibrate on blinded positive and interference spectra

fragment_alignment_tolerance_da.future_action: calibrate against observed fragment mass error

guardrails.note: cosine 0.7 and six matches borrow common GNPS defaults; 50 percent explained intensity is a project guardrail

statuses.conflicting_spectra: Enough matched ions exist but at least one identity guardrail fails
statuses.insufficient_evidence: Both spectra exist but fewer than six fragments match
statuses.not_evaluable: The acquisition/window/signal cannot yield a two-spectrum comparison
statuses.not_attempted: Two retention-time coordinates were not supplied

manual_review_required_for: rows with strongly asymmetric unmatched intensity or shared RT/DIA targets
supported rows near a decision boundary
a representative audit sample of supported rows

future_calibration.required_truth: authentic same-compound positives plus structurally related/interference negatives
future_calibration.report: confidence intervals, confusion matrix, threshold stability, and held-out performance
